tasks.title: Caching: Prefetch on hover
tasks.spec: Implement and verify Prefetch on hover.

tasks.title: Caching: Preload critical chunks
tasks.spec: Implement and verify Preload critical chunks.

tasks.title: Audit all package-lock.json deps
tasks.spec: Check for high/critical vulnerabilities via npm audit.

tasks.title: Tauri IPC fuzzing
tasks.spec: Fuzz tauri invoke commands

tasks.title: CWE-1321 Prototype Pollution
tasks.spec: Audit deepmerge/lodash usages

tasks.title: CWE-79 XSS sink check
tasks.spec: Audit all raw HTML sets

tasks.title: XSS prevention in cell formula renderer
tasks.spec: Audit FormulaEngine + ReportBuilder cell HTML rendering. Add DOMPurify sanitize on every untrusted formula output. Block onerror/onload/javascript: scheme in hyperlinks.

tasks.title: CSV/Excel formula injection prevention
tasks.spec: Prefix =+-@ cells on import. Sanitize first char in every cell value during CSV import. Test with =cmd|" /C calc"!A0 attack vector.

tasks.title: Hyperlink URL allowlist
tasks.spec: Only http/https/mailto/tel schemes allowed in cell hyperlinks. Block javascript:, data:, vbscript:, file:. Provide escape hatch for trusted internal domains.

tasks.title: CSP report-only then enforce
tasks.spec: Add Content-Security-Policy meta to index.html with report-uri. Start report-only, log violations, then move to enforce.

tasks.title: CSP for Tauri webview
tasks.spec: Add CSP via tauri.conf.json with connect-src/img-src/style-src allowlist for offline-first app.

tasks.title: Subresource Integrity for vendor scripts
tasks.spec: Add SRI hash to every external <script> and <link>. Use sha384 baseline.

tasks.title: Tauri allowlist minimalism
tasks.spec: Trim tauri.conf.json allowlist to only required commands. Each plugin capability must justify its inclusion.

tasks.title: Tauri command input validation
tasks.spec: Use zod schemas to validate every Tauri command input from webview. Reject unknown keys.

tasks.title: IndexedDB encryption at rest
tasks.spec: Wrap all IndexedDB payloads with AES-GCM via Web Crypto API. Key derived via PBKDF2 from user passphrase.

tasks.title: Master storage encryption audit
tasks.spec: Verify masterStorage persists only ciphertext. No plaintext in dev tools.

tasks.title: Token rotation cadence
tasks.spec: Verify tokenRotation utility rotates every 15min idle, 24h hard limit, single-use refresh token.

tasks.title: Session hijack prevention
tasks.spec: Bind session to (ip+userAgent+canvasFingerprint). Invalidate on mismatch with grace period.

tasks.title: Brute force auth protection
tasks.spec: Add exponential backoff after 3 failed attempts. CAPTCHA at 5. Lockout at 10 within 15min.

tasks.title: Auth token expiry enforcement
tasks.spec: Test token TTL on idle + absolute. Refresh flow must re-auth on expired refresh token.

tasks.title: Refresh token reuse detection
tasks.spec: Reuse triggers family revocation. Test stolen-then-replayed scenario.

tasks.title: WebAuthn passkey registration
tasks.spec: Add WebAuthn enrollment for desktop users. TouchID/Windows Hello.

tasks.title: Biometric unlock for Tauri
tasks.spec: Use @tauri-apps/plugin-biometric (if available) or keychain integration.

tasks.title: TOTP fallback path
tasks.spec: Backup codes + SMS fallback for when TOTP device is lost.

tasks.title: File upload size limits
tasks.spec: Enforce 50MB import, 100MB attachment limits. Reject with clear error before reading bytes.

tasks.title: File content-type validation
tasks.spec: Check magic bytes, not just MIME from form. Reject .xlsx containing HTML.

tasks.title: Malware scanning for imports
tasks.spec: Run ClamAV-like signature check on workbook imports. At minimum: macro presence detection.

tasks.title: DDE safety in Excel imports
tasks.spec: Disable DDE in exceljs parser. Strip =DDE() formulas.

tasks.title: XLM macro safety
tasks.spec: Strip XLM macros from imported workbooks. Microsoft documents attack surface.

tasks.title: HTML sanitization in cell comments
tasks.spec: Use DOMPurify with strict allowlist for cell rich-text. Strip script/style/event handlers.

tasks.title: NLQ input sanitization
tasks.spec: NLQEngine.ts: sanitize user prompt. Block prompt-injection attempts targeting LLM.

tasks.title: Prompt injection in LLM calls
tasks.spec: Wrap all @huggingface/transformers calls with system-prompt isolation. Test with indirect injection payloads.

tasks.title: Plugin sandbox escape audit
tasks.spec: Audit PluginSandbox.ts for postMessage/Iframe boundary leaks. Block DOM access beyond iframe.

tasks.title: Plugin permission model
tasks.spec: Per-plugin capability tokens. User must grant network, file, clipboard explicitly.

tasks.title: Plugin API resource limits
tasks.spec: Cap plugin memory, CPU, and API call rate.

tasks.title: Plugin version negotiation
tasks.spec: Plugin manifest declares min/max host version. Reject incompatible at load.

tasks.title: Plugin marketplace signing
tasks.spec: Ed25519 sign plugin bundles. Verify against pinned public key.

tasks.title: Dependency vulnerability scan
tasks.spec: npm audit --omit=dev + OSV-Scanner in CI. Block on critical/high.

tasks.title: License compliance check
tasks.spec: Verify no GPL/AGPL contamination. Allow MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3.

tasks.title: Secret leakage in bundle
tasks.spec: Scan dist/ for API keys, tokens, .env values. Fail build on match.

tasks.title: Console.* in production
tasks.spec: Ensure console.log/info/debug are stripped from prod bundle. Keep warn/error.

tasks.title: Error message PII scrubbing
tasks.spec: Scrub emails, phone, SSN, credit card from any error message before logging.

tasks.title: Email PII detection in cells
tasks.spec: Auto-classify cells containing PII. Enforce column-level encryption.

tasks.title: Data classification enforcement
tasks.spec: Tag every model field with classification: public|internal|confidential|restricted.

tasks.title: GDPR right to erasure
tasks.spec: User can request full data wipe across all stores, workers, IndexedDB, Tauri.

tasks.title: CCPA opt-out signals
tasks.spec: Honor Global Privacy Control header on web.

tasks.title: HIPAA audit log integrity
tasks.spec: Append-only hash-chained audit log. Detect tampering.

tasks.title: SOX segregation of duties
tasks.spec: WorkflowEngine must enforce role separation: preparer ≠ approver ≠ admin.

tasks.title: Encrypted backups at rest
tasks.spec: Backup files use AES-256-GCM with user-derived key.

tasks.title: Key escrow recovery flow
tasks.spec: Optional recovery key printed at setup, hashed and stored separately.
